title: GitLab week 8 review - runners and Auto DevOps
description: Eight questions on self-managed runners, config.toml, executors and Auto DevOps.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between a runner's scope and its tags?

options.text: Scope says which projects may use it; tags say which jobs it will take

questions.explanation: A group runner with tag deploy takes only deploy-tagged jobs from the group's projects.

questions.prompt: Why should a private runner not accept untagged jobs?

options.text: Otherwise every job in the project lands on it, not just the ones that need it

questions.explanation: Tag the runner and the jobs that need it.

questions.prompt: concurrent = 4 and one [[runners]] entry with limit = 1. How many of its jobs run at once?
questions.explanation: limit caps one entry; concurrent caps the host across entries.

questions.prompt: What is the trade-off between docker:dind and mounting /var/run/docker.sock?

options.text: dind isolates a daemon per job but is slower and needs privileged; the socket shares the host daemon (fast layer cache) but jobs can see each other's containers
The socket needs privileged, dind does not

questions.prompt: When does Auto DevOps apply to a project?

options.text: When it is enabled and the project has no .gitlab-ci.yml of its own

questions.explanation: Your own file wins; include the template to mix.

questions.prompt: Which two things must exist before Auto DevOps' deploy stages run?

options.text: A connected Kubernetes cluster (agent) and KUBE_INGRESS_BASE_DOMAIN with wildcard DNS
A paid plan and a token
Helm and kubectl in the repo

questions.explanation: Without them build and test still run; deploys are skipped.

questions.prompt: How do you give the Auto DevOps-deployed app a secret environment variable without touching YAML?
questions.explanation: K8S_SECRET_* becomes a Kubernetes Secret exposed to the pods.

questions.prompt: Your .gitlab-ci.yml defines a job with the same name as an Auto DevOps template job. What happens?

options.text: Your keys merge over the template's, the rest is kept

questions.explanation: Same-name jobs merge like extends; *_DISABLED variables or rules: when: never remove one.
